title: You're invited to a free cholesterol check
body: High cholesterol often runs in families and is easy to treat when it is found early. We'd like to offer you a free blood test at a health centre near you.
detail: It takes about 10 minutes. You don't need to fast.
why_a: Your health programme offers this check to families where it may matter. It is your choice, and it is free.
privacy: Your answer and your result are private. Only you and your health centre see them.
booked_body: Nothing to prepare. We'll send a reminder the day before.
declined_body: You won't hear from us again about this. If you change your mind, ask at any health centre.
already_body: Would you like your health centre to pass your result to the programme, so nobody contacts you again?
already_done: Noted. Thank you for letting us know.
call_body: Someone from the programme will phone you in the next few days.
closed_body: If you still want a check, ask at any health centre.
mock: Demo only. No message was sent and no appointment was made.
error: That didn't work. Please try again.
